## 1. DC-7 Truganina pilot — throughput review

Tomas Rehnqvist presented four weeks of steady-state data from the DC-7
Truganina automation pilot.

- Sustained conveyor throughput is **1,180 cartons per hour**.
- The contracted design target is **1,450 cartons per hour**.
- The gap is attributed to induction-lane jams on mixed-carton waves, not to
  the sortation hardware itself.
- Kestrelworks has acknowledged the shortfall in writing but has not yet
  confirmed the associated service credit.

Junie Whitlam-Ferreira asked whether the shortfall was seasonal. Tomas
confirmed it is not: the four weeks span both a promotional and a
non-promotional cycle and the variance between them is under 3%.

## 2. Capital position

Ellery Dunmore reported the pilot is **$312,000 over the approved capex
envelope**, driven almost entirely by the second induction lane added in
June 2026. Contingency remaining is **$180,000**.

The programme sits inside the **$96,000,000** three-year supply chain
transformation envelope approved in the FY26–FY28 group strategy.

## 3. Commercial position — Kestrelworks

Callum Vasey confirmed the master services agreement provides for a service
credit of **4.5% of the quarterly licence fee** where sustained throughput
falls below 85% of the design target. At 1,180 against 1,450 the pilot is at
81.4%, so the credit is triggered. Kestrelworks has not yet confirmed this in
writing.

## 4. Risk register

- **R-114 — Single-source dependency on Kestrelworks for conveyor spares.**
  Rated **High**. No qualified second supplier exists for the induction-lane
  drive units; lead time on a replacement unit is 14 weeks.
- **R-118 — Store systems cutover coupled to DC-7 go-live.** Rated Medium.
- **R-121 — Peak-season freeze window from 3 November 2026.** Rated Medium.

## 5. Decisions recorded

- **D-1:** Phase 2 (Dandenong South) is **deferred to FY27**. The committee
  will not seek investment approval for phase 2 in the current financial year.
- **D-2:** Contingency is **held at $180,000**. It is not to be drawn down to
  absorb the current variance without a further paper to the committee.

## 6. Go / no-go

The DC-7 go / no-go decision is set for **9 October 2026**. Revised criteria
are to be circulated in advance.
